summary: Creates named constant-value CHOP channels. Use it for stable control signals, default values, slider snapshots, parameter exports, and one-sample or interval-length control channels with explicit extend behavior.

key_params.name: const
key_params.note: Sequence of channel name/value pairs.

key_params.name: const0name
key_params.note: Channel name or Pattern Expansion expression.

key_params.name: const0value
key_params.note: Constant value for the generated channel.

key_params.name: snap
key_params.note: Snapshot the first input's channel names and values into the Constant CHOP.

key_params.name: first
key_params.note: First incoming channel to use during Snapshot Input.

key_params.name: current
key_params.note: Require this CHOP to be current for the second Active input to affect values.

key_params.name: single
key_params.note: Use a one-sample channel interval when enabled.

key_params.name: start
key_params.note: Start of the channel interval.

key_params.name: startunit
key_params.note: Units for Start: samples, frames, or seconds.

key_params.name: end
key_params.note: End of the channel interval.

key_params.name: endunit
key_params.note: Units for End: samples, frames, or seconds.

key_params.name: rate
key_params.note: Sample rate of the generated channels.

key_params.name: left
key_params.note: Extend behavior before the channel range.

key_params.name: right
key_params.note: Extend behavior after the channel range.

key_params.name: defval
key_params.note: Value used by the Default Value extend condition.

key_params.name: timeslice
key_params.note: Force output channels to be time sliced.

key_params.name: scope
key_params.note: Channel scope affected by common CHOP operations.

key_params.name: srselect
key_params.note: Sample-rate match behavior for multiple input CHOPs.

key_params.name: exportmethod
key_params.note: Method used to export channels to parameters.

key_params.name: autoexportroot
key_params.note: Root node used by Channel Name is Path:Parameter exports.

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT table used by DAT Table export methods.

common_gotchas: The Name field creates channels only when it contains a name or Pattern Expansion expression; blank name slots do not create channels.
Constant CHOP outputs are one sample long by default; turn off Single Sample and use the Channel page Start/End/Rate fields for longer intervals.
Snapshot Input can pull names and values from a Parameter CHOP or other input CHOP; script the same action with par.snap.pulse().
The second Active input adds offsets only when it is greater than zero, and Active Needs Current can limit that behavior to the current CHOP.
First Channel is useful when snapshotting more incoming channels than the Constant CHOP can hold in one operator.
